model_annotations.Bulgarian: This image shows a page from an academic paper presented at ICPP, September 08–11, 2025, San Diego, CA, authored by DanYing Ge, JianHua Gao, QiZhi Jiang, YiFei Feng, and WeiXiang Ji. The page is formatted in a two-column layout typical of conference proceedings and discusses a system called TaskSpec, a speculative decoding approach tailored to downstream tasks in large language models (LLMs). The left column covers topics including the relationship between language model scale and performance, the trade-offs between drafting accuracy and inference cost, and the context-dependent nature of token co-occurrence patterns across different domains. At the bottom left of the page, there is a partially visible figure (referenced as Figure 2) that appears to show two visualizations labeled (a) and (b), depicting token distributions or co-occurrence patterns in the domains of chemistry and mathematics, though the figure is largely cut off. The page also includes the beginning of Section 2, titled "TASKSPEC," with a subsection "Overview" that is partially visible at the bottom right. No line charts or pie charts are present on this page; the content is predominantly textual with standard academic formatting, citations in bracketed numerical style, and a partially cropped figure at the lower left.
